title: BC Friday Tips #88 Extract Apps from a Docker Container
summary: A Docker tip for Business Central developers showing how to extract the Applications folder from a Docker container to a local PC using the docker cp command for quick access to standard Microsoft apps and extensions.
key_points: Docker cp command copies the entire Applications folder from a Business Central container to local storage
Provides quick local access to standard Microsoft apps and extensions for development purposes
Simplifies developer workflow and everyday Business Central development tasks

quotes.text: You can easily copy the entire Applications folder from your Business Central docker container to your local PC
quotes.why_it_matters: Introduces a simple technique for accessing container contents during development
